meta.notes: The app tags it "YUANDAO DSP Device" and files it under YUANDAO; it is sold as a NiceHCK product, so that is its brand here. Its official presets: 1 Tears (flat), 2 Balanced, 3 Rock, 4 Game (game mode), 5 Diffusion (diffuse mode), 8 bands each, pre-gain 0. Game mode on writes preset 4 and off writes the preset that was on before, as the app's special modes do; there is no mode command. Like the PureAural it leaves stale bytes in its answers, so the app shows its firmware (0.2) as "0.".
